description: Configures the Device Defender audit settings for this account. Settings include how audit notifications are sent and which audit checks are enabled or disabled.. Source:- https://github.com/aws-cloudformation/aws-cloudformation-resource-providers-iot.git

AuditCheckConfigurations.description: Specifies which audit checks are enabled and disabled for this account.
AuditCheckConfigurations.title: AWSIoTAccountAuditConfigurationAuditCheckConfigurationsDefinition

AuditNotificationTargetConfigurations.description: Information about the targets to which audit notifications are sent.
AuditNotificationTargetConfigurations.title: AWSIoTAccountAuditConfigurationAuditNotificationTargetConfigurationsDefinition

AuditCheckConfiguration.description: The configuration for a specific audit check.

Enabled.description: True if the check is enabled.

AuditCheckConfiguration.title: AWSIoTAccountAuditConfigurationAuditCheckConfigurationDefinition

DeviceCertAgeAuditCheckConfiguration.description: A structure containing the configName and corresponding configValue for configuring DeviceCertAgeCheck.

DeviceCertAgeAuditCheckConfiguration.title: AWSIoTAccountAuditConfigurationDeviceCertAgeAuditCheckConfigurationDefinition

DeviceCertExpirationAuditCheckConfigurat.description: A structure containing the configName and corresponding configValue for configuring DeviceCertExpirationCheck.

DeviceCertExpirationAuditCheckConfigurat.title: AWSIoTAccountAuditConfigurationDeviceCertExpirationAuditCheckConfigurationDefinition

TargetArn.description: The ARN of the target (SNS topic) to which audit notifications are sent.

ConfigValue.description: The configValue for configuring audit checks.

CertExpirationCheckCustomConfiguration.description: A structure containing the configName and corresponding configValue for configuring audit checks.
CertExpirationCheckCustomConfiguration.title: AWSIoTAccountAuditConfigurationCertExpirationCheckCustomConfigurationDefinition

AccountId.description: Your 12-digit account ID (used as the primary identifier for the CloudFormation resource).
